descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'YHWH has judged,' referring primarily to the king of Judah (son of Asa) and also to other individuals (a recorder under David/Solomon, the father of Jehu). With 84 occurrences, all three clusters represent the same proper noun in different prepositional and case frames: nominative/conjunctive, with lamed ('to Jehoshaphat'), and with lamed-possessive ('of Jehoshaphat') (eng 'Jehoshaphat/Yehoshafat,' spa 'Josafat/Yehoshafat,' arb 'يَهُوشَافَاطُ,' kor '여호샤받/여호사밟,' swa 'Yehoshafati,' hin 'यहोशापाट/यहोशापात').
